2610.04777.title: ARISE: Adaptive Agentic Reasoning with Image-grounded Self-Evaluation for Interpretable IBD Assessment
2610.04777.paper_summary: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) requires frequent imaging-based assessment, yet interpretation of modalities such as wireless capsule endoscopy (WCE) and intestinal ultrasound remains heavily dependent on specialist expertise. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate significant potential in multimodal medical image analysis, but their clinical adoption is hindered by their insufficient domain-specific reasoning, susceptibility to hallucination, scarcity of high quality training data in fine-grained diagnostics and limited interpretability. We introduce ARISE (Adaptive Agentic Reasoning with Image-grounded Self-Evaluation), an autonomous planning framework that models few-shot medical image understanding as a sequential agentic workflow. ARISE structures agent execution into a transparent 5-stage workflow: hypothesis generation, image-grounded evidence summarization, evidence-conditioned refinement, symbolic verification, and final diagnosis. We apply ARISE to IBD assessment across two independent patient cohorts: wireless capsule endoscopy (WCE) images for Crohn's disease and B-mode ultrasound data for ulcerative colitis. ARISE consistently improves diagnostic performance over baseline VLMs while exposing where reasoning succeeds or fails, providing a more interpretable basis for clinical decision support and realistic deployment.
2610.04777.paper_summary_zh: 炎症性腸病（IBD）需要頻繁的影像學評估，但對於無線膠囊內視鏡（WCE）和腸道超聲等技術的解讀仍然高度依賴專家的專業知識。視覺-語言模型（VLMs）在多模態醫學影像分析中顯示出顯著潛力，但其臨床應用受到領域特定推理不足、易受幻覺影響、高質量訓練數據稀缺以及解釋性有限的阻礙。我們介紹ARISE（基於影像的自我評估的自適應代理推理），這是一個將少樣本醫學影像理解建模為序列代理工作流程的自主規劃框架。ARISE將代理執行結構化為透明的五階段工作流程：假設生成、基於影像的證據摘要、基於證據的精煉、符號驗證和最終診斷。我們將ARISE應用於兩個獨立患者群體的IBD評估：克隆病的無線膠囊內視鏡（WCE）影像和潰瘍性結腸炎的B-mode超聲數據。ARISE在診斷性能上始終優於基線VLMs，同時揭示推理成功或失敗的地方，為臨床決策支持和現實部署提供了更具可解釋性的基礎。
